source.title: Glimmering Gemdust - Item - World of Warcraft
source.author: Cardinalai

notes: One firsthand mixed-gem crushing study: 180 Tenebrous Amethyst, 150 Harandar Peridot, 87 Amani Lapis, 63 Sanguine Garnet (all silver quality); 40.7% resourcefulness and max knowledge skills; author reports 330 Glimmering Gemdust and 160 Dusk-Shrouded Stone. Mixed inputs mean this cannot be attributed to any single gem type. Output quality rank and number of crushing casts unknown; do not calculate per-cast probabilities or assume all 480 gems were consumed in the dust-producing recipe.
requirements: Midnight Jewelcrafting Crushing; max knowledge skills; 40.7% resourcefulness
